english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for hidden knowledge that someone intends to keep hidden.
Use this when a mystery is a secret or concealed information, not for something that is simply baffling.

examples.english: You can't tell anyone this secret.
examples.traditional: 呢個秘密你唔可以同人講。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 bei3 mat6 nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 jan4 gong2

examples.english: This mystery is our secret, so don't tell anyone.
examples.traditional: 呢個係我哋之間嘅秘密，唔好同人講。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 bei3 mat6 m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2
